target.statement: Accuracy of XGB on the adversarial holdout set for IoT-23 binary classification (regular training), reported as 68.35%

compute.basis: Only the A2PM attack library is released; the full pipeline (preprocessing, grid search, adversarial training, evasion loop) must be reimplemented, and IoT-23 must be downloaded and preprocessed, but all models are CPU tree ensembles on ~1M samples.

blockers: No end-to-end code/configs released for the paper's pipeline (only the A2PM library)
Exact preprocessing (feature selection, one-hot encoding, low-frequency category aggregation) and grid-search ranges are only partially specified
A2PM evasion loop with up to 30 attempts per malicious sample can be slow on CPU
title: Towards Adversarial Realism and Robust Learning for IoT Intrusion Detection and Classification
